outcome: An order placed more than 30 days ago cannot be cancelled

requirements.text: An order placed more than 30 days ago cannot be cancelled; exactly 30 days or less still can, and the customer is told why
A shipped order cannot be cancelled at any age
requirements.exclusionReason: this rule exists today and has no test; the Goal does not change it

requirements.text: Cancelling must stay fast for the nightly clean-up job

exclusions: Shipped orders: the rule exists today and is not changed here

acceptance.text: An order placed more than 30 days ago is refused and stays open
acceptance.given: an open order placed 31 days ago
acceptance.then: the cancellation is refused with a message that says why, and the order stays open
boundaries: placed exactly 30 days ago: still cancellable

acceptance.text: An order placed 30 days ago or less can be cancelled
acceptance.given: an open order placed 30 days ago, or less

acceptance.text: 1000 cancellations take less than 5 ms at the 99th percentile
acceptance.given: 1000 open orders of ages from 0 to 24 days
acceptance.then: the p99 of one such round is under 5 ms
